newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eight ships loading wheat in Rouen, eight more due.
newsitem.headline: Eight ships loading wheat in Rouen, eight more due.

text.p: Eight ships are loading a total of 133,000 tonnes of wheat at Rouen, port officials said on Tuesday.
The wheat is for export to west Africa, Algeria, Egypt, Eritrea, Italy, and Poland, they said.
One ship is also loading 16,000 tonnes of barley at Rouen destined for south Africa.
Eight more ships are expected in port by March 9 to load around 116,000 tonnes of wheat.
One vessel is also due in Rouen by March 9 to load 58,000 tonnes of barley, they said.
